{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": "import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

reg = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "registry.json").read_text())
records = reg.get("households") or reg.get("records") or reg.get("families") or reg

active = [r for r in records if r.get("status") != "merged" and not r.get("merged_into")]
merged = [r for r in records if r.get("status") == "merged" or r.get("merged_into")]

print(f"total={len(records)} active={len(active)} merged={len(merged)}")
for r in merged:
    print("merged:", r.get("household_id"), "->", r.get("merged_into"))

audit = (ROOT / "data" / "audit.jsonl")
lines = audit.read_text().strip().splitlines() if audit.exists() else []
print(f"audit lines: {len(lines)}")
for line in lines[-5:]:
    print("audit:", line)
", "path": "scripts/verify_merge.py", "step": "P2"}}
